summary_en: The Oita Bank executed an off-hours block purchase of 475,000 shares (0.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at ¥2,526 per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 10, 2026, for a total of approximately ¥1.20 billion. This execution is part of a broader acquisition authorization for up to 700,000 shares (0.9% of shares) up to ¥1.5 billion through November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-hours Block Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, The Oita Bank's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock and determined the specific execution method for an off-hours block purchase. On November 10, 2026, the bank executed a purchase of 475,000 ordinary shares at ¥2,526 per share via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours block trading system) at 8:45 a.m. The total purchase amount was approximately ¥1.20 billion, representing 0.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

This execution is the first tranche of a broader acquisition authorization resolved on the same date. The authorization permits the bank to acquire up to 700,000 shares (0.9% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥1.5 billion through November 30, 2026, using two methods: discretionary block purchases through the Tokyo Stock Exchange and additional off-hours block purchases via ToSTNeT-3. The purchase order on November 10 was limited to the specific trading time slot, and no change was made to the authorized quantity of 475,000 shares for this execution.
